description: Airport Overlay District is a dataset listed in City of Baton Rouge open data portal (data.brla.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Baton Rouge. Polygon geometry with attributes displaying overlay districts within East Baton Rouge Parish, Louisiana. Coverage: Baton Rouge. The portal files it under the category Housing and Development. Its tags are zoning, gis, overlay, planning, district. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Information Services. The portal shows 2026-06-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-brla-gov-portal.
